g.text: MNT Auto Revert — How it works

div.p: 【1】 MCP agent modifies a file on /mnt/c/ (draw.io, SVG, PNG, etc.) 【2】 Extension polls every 2s — compares file mtime on disk vs last known 【3】 If changed: text files get silent revert, images/SVG get tab close+reopen
Why? WSL2 inotify doesn't detect /mnt/ changes → polling is the workaround
